page.overview:
Who is Bosvarga?

Bosvarga was an alien mercenary who worked alongside his identical twin, Cerensco. They accompanied the assassin Ochi of Bestoon when he reclaimed his starship, Bestoon Legacy, after it was hijacked by Dathan and Miramir to lead Ochi away from their daughter, Rey. The twins aimed their blasters at the couple as Ochi killed them with his dagger. With his bloodlust unsatisfied, the assassin then repeatedly stabbed Bosvarga and Cerensco to death.
